background: HSBC UK Bank plc is the ring-fenced retail and commercial bank of HSBC in Britain, funded by UK personal and business deposits and lending on residential mortgages and to UK companies, including first direct.
synthesis: Fitch rates the bank AA after its upgrade on 12 May 2026, S&P A+ and Moody's A1, with S&P and, since 18 Sep 2026, Moody's on positive outlook. Capital is mixed against UK majors: CET1 of 13.2% is in the bottom quarter but leverage of 5.6% is in the top quarter. Liquidity is strong, with LCR of 160% above the peer median and NSFR of 143% in the top quarter, though since 30 Jun 2025 LCR has fallen 26 points and NSFR 8 points. The only flagged items are the Moody's positive outlooks on its deposit and issuer ratings.
